calls.title: Growthbook <> Careforth - Intro/Demo
calls.summary: Careforth is exploring a long-term A/B testing solution to enhance their website, particularly for the chatbot feature and lead generation pages. The team requires a platform that can conduct split URL testing with sticky sessions while prioritizing strict healthcare compliance, including PII/PHI protections and limitations on cookies. Future use cases may involve geolocation targeting. The chosen solution must empower marketing teams with self-service capabilities, allowing for traffic adjustments without engineering support. GrowthBook emerges as a strong candidate, offering features like targeted rollouts, integration with data warehouses, and robust statistical analysis, despite its higher pricing range of $30,000 to $40,000 annually. A longer trial period is sought for comprehensive evaluation.
calls.keywords: A/B testing, Healthcare compliance, Feature flags, Split URL experiment, Data warehouse, GrowthBook demo
